newsitem.title: USA: Fluor unit gets Yanpet contract.
newsitem.headline: Fluor unit gets Yanpet contract.

text.p: Fluor Daniel, a unit of Fluor Corp, said it was awarded a contract by Saudi Yanbu Petrochemical Company (Yanpet) to double the capacity of Yanpet's petrochemicals complex in Yanbu, Saudi Arabia.
The complex is a joint venture between Mobil Corp's Mobil Yanbu Petrochemicals Co Inc, and Saudi Basic Industries Corp. The installed cost is about $2 billion.

The expansion will include construction of a second 800,000-metric-ton-per-year ethylene cracker and facilities to convert ethylene into 535,000 tons of polyethylene and 410,000 tons of ethylene glycol a year.
The plant will also produce 260,000 tons of polypropylene and 125,000 tons of pyrolysis gasoline annually. Production from the existing Yanpet plant at Yanbu began in 1985.
